recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male figure in 1990s-era country attire, leaning against a railing in a soft-focus outdoor setting. The composition features a warm, golden-hour palette with prominent, layered serif typography positioned across the subject's midsection.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head in the upper third
Typography layered over the subject's torso and the background railing
Soft-focus background elements contrasting with the sharp subject and text
Warm skin tones and golden text color harmonizing with the neutral blue shirt
coreInvariants: Soft-focus urban background with a 'Hotel' sign
Subject leaning on a horizontal railing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies roughly 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large yellow display name.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the large yellow name, then to the white subtitle, and finally to the hands on the railing.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper corners and sides are filled with a blurred, warm-toned architectural background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light blue (denim shirt and jeans) providing a cool base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, moderate saturation; the image has a soft, glowing quality characteristic of film photography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same serif family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal railing as a compositional divider
Blurred background 'Hotel' sign for environmental context

preserve: Golden yellow and white color scheme

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif with similar stroke contrast and weight.
Provides the elegant, traditional feel of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with 90s feathered hair and a mustache, wearing a light blue button-down denim shirt and jeans. He is leaning his arms on a dark horizontal railing at an outdoor cafe. The background is a soft-focus urban street with a blurred 'HOTEL' sign in the upper left. Warm, golden-hour lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large all-caps serif text in golden yellow across the center of the image. Below it, add a smaller line of all-caps serif text in white with wide letter spacing. Apply a subtle drop shadow to both lines for readability against the shirt.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text golden yellow?
Is the subtitle white and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of yellow for the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow text is the most prominent element.
Ensure the man's pose looks natural and relaxed.
Verify the background blur doesn't obscure the 'Hotel' context entirely.
Confirm the serif font feels traditional rather than modern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned 90s portrait with centered, layered serif typography using a yellow-and-white color palette.
